record_checksum: first four SHA-256 bytes of type/body
owned_event: EVENT record subscription/relay bytes 255/255 mean a locally staged verified original, with its actual signing key and timestamp; no relay cursor is advanced
queue_reference: type 7: id:32 and target-relay-mask:u64be; references a previously retained original and never stores a second representation; unavailable in NCJ1
completed_publications: The final OK retires its active publish slot. Frozen targets and accepted/refused observations stay with the retained original and survive checkpoint/replay; the 64-publish bound counts unresolved outgoing events. NCJ1 behavior is unchanged.
compatibility: new explicit account-scoped NCJ2; never reinterprets NCJ1
